patch_description: The current version only polishes 3 fixed seeds. Evidence in the prompt suggests independent restarts are the main driver of quality but saturate; the lowest-risk structural additions are (a) many deterministic jittered restarts around the best layouts, and (b) merging/perturbing with a shrinking-step stochastic hill climb (which the earlier successful programs used). I add a stochastic shrinking-perturbation phase (fixed seed) applied after each polish, plus a multi-restart loop generating jittered variants of each base layout. This substantially increases search coverage at modest time cost while keeping determinism and the existing fallback/error handling intact.
